quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 44

questions.question: At a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for cars behind you.
Move when the car ahead of you moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, look left first. Traffic from the left is closer to you. Then look right. Then look left again to check for any vehicles you might have missed.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:

options.text: Slow down.
Pass with caution.
Do not pass.
Keep right on hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line on your side means you cannot pass other vehicles from your direction.

questions.question: You may cross double solid yellow lines:

options.text: To pass a slow-moving truck.
To turn into a driveway.
To pass another car.
Under no conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: To turn into a driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into a driveway, to exit a highway, or to make a U-turn where allowed.

questions.question: You may carefully continue through an intersection with a yellow light if:

options.text: An emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
Pedestrians are crossing.
You are turning right.
You were already in the intersection when the light turned yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You were already in the intersection when the light turned yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you may continue through carefully.

questions.question: Drive below the speed limit when:

options.text: Road or weather conditions are not perfect.
You see a police car.
You are entering a highway with other cars.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road or weather conditions are not perfect.
questions.explanation: Drive below the speed limit when the road is wet, slippery, or visibility is poor. You can be ticketed for driving too fast for the conditions, even if you are within the speed limit.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane, two-way road, you must:

options.text: Not cross the centerline.
Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.
Use the shoulder.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: On a two-lane road, you must use the oncoming traffic lane to pass. Only pass if it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means:

options.text: Stop and look, then go if there is no traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to clear the intersection.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: A driver with a probationary license may use a phone while driving if they are:

options.text: A high school graduate.
Making a 911 emergency call.
Only texting, not talking.
Using a hands-free device.

questions.correctAnswerText: Making a 911 emergency call.
questions.explanation: In Indiana, probationary license holders under age 21 cannot use any phone while driving, except to call 911 for an emergency.

questions.question: When two vehicles enter an intersection at the same time, which one must yield?

options.text: Either one
The vehicle on the left
The vehicle on the right
Neither

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time, the vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.

questions.question: Points on your license stay on your record for:

options.text: Six months.
Nine months.
One year.
Two years.

questions.correctAnswerText: Two years.
questions.explanation: In Indiana, points stay on your driving record for two years from the date of the traffic conviction.

questions.question: Driving without liability insurance:

options.text: Is against the law.
Is not illegal but is not recommended.
Will result in no legal repercussions.
Is required.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is against the law.
questions.explanation: All drivers must have liability insurance. The state requires at least $25,000 coverage for one person's injury or death, $50,000 for two or more people, and $25,000 for property damage. This is called 25/50/10 liability insurance.

questions.question: You are driving on a one-way street and see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights. You must:

options.text: Drive with your flashers turned on.
Move to the nearest roadside and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down until the vehicle passes you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the nearest roadside and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches on a one-way street, move to the nearest roadside and stop.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:

options.text: Flat.
Curvy.
In the sun.
Shaded.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shaded.
questions.explanation: In cold or wet weather, shaded areas under trees or buildings freeze faster than other parts of the road. These areas also take longer to dry.

questions.question: A bicyclist who breaks traffic laws:

options.text: Is in the right because bicyclists don't have to obey traffic laws.
Can be ticketed.
Will always receive a warning from law enforcement.
Will have their bicycle impounded.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can be ticketed.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights and duties as drivers. Both can be ticketed for breaking traffic laws.

questions.question: If two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time:

options.text: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
The vehicle on the right must yield to the vehicle on the left.
Drivers must make hand motions to communicate with each other.
One driver should proceed without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
questions.explanation: Usually, vehicles at a four-way stop go in the order they arrive. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.

questions.question: When passing a large vehicle, a small vehicle driver must be prepared for:

options.text: Loud noises.
Excess air pollution.
Wind gusts from the large vehicle.
Falling vehicle parts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wind gusts from the large vehicle.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles create strong wind gusts that can push small vehicles off course. Be ready to steer correctly when passing large vehicles moving at high speeds.

questions.question: You reach an intersection with a flashing red light. You must:

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn either right or left, since the road is blocked ahead.
Stop at the intersection and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop at the intersection, then proceed when traffic allows.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop at the intersection, then proceed when traffic allows.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop completely. After stopping, proceed when it is safe and traffic allows.

questions.question: To reduce headlight glare at night, you should look:

options.text: Straight ahead.
Over your shoulder.
At the center of the road.
To the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: To the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: If oncoming headlights are too bright, look toward the right side of the road. Do not look directly at the bright lights because the glare can blind you for several seconds.

questions.question: A good rule for passing is:

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
Move to the front of slow traffic so you can see better.
Always flash your lights and honk to alert other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
questions.explanation: Each pass increases the chance of a collision. If you pass one car, you may need to pass others. Drive with traffic flow at legal speeds and pass only when necessary.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may misalign because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning if the shoulder has water.
Losing control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply to get back on the road. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show direction and distance information to drivers.

options.text: Yellow
Red
Green
White

questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background. They show direction and distance to specific places. They help drivers find their way in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Four-lane traffic ahead.
Divided highway ahead.
Two-way traffic ahead.
Intersection ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Left lane must turn left.
Left turn on arrow only.
Steep downgrade.
Deer crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left lane must turn left.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a full stop. You must yield to vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from specific lanes. A solid red arrow:

options.text: Is never used as a traffic signal.
Means the same thing as a circular red traffic light.
Means drivers may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Means traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Means the same thing as a circular red traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same thing as a circular red light. Traffic in that lane must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is okay for other drivers to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than a motorcycle with one rider.
When passing a motorcycle, you must move completely into the other lane.
You can expect a motorcycle's brake lights to come on when the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: When passing a motorcycle, you must move completely into the other lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need the full width of a lane. Make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: No left turn.
No U-turns.
No exit.
No right turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Bicycle crossing.
Stop only if other cars are approaching.
Bicycle store.
Soft shoulders.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles often cross or ride beside the road.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an intersection. The light is green but oncoming traffic is heavy. You should:

options.text: Use the next intersection.
Wait at the edge of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Wait in the middle of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Turn because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the middle of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: When turning left with oncoming traffic, wait for that traffic to pass before you turn. You may move into the intersection to prepare for your left turn if the light is green and no other car ahead is turning left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop.
No U-turn.
Yield.
Do not enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street in the wrong direction.
U-turns are not allowed.
You can go if the road is clear.
Stop completely before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street in the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are driving the wrong way. This puts you at risk of hitting another car head-on. Turn around safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not turn right.
You must turn right.
Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not turn right.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. In this case, the right turn is not allowed.

questions.question: Two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time. What happens?

options.text: The larger vehicle has the right-of-way.
The car on the left has the right-of-way.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver can then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left turn signal.
Extra lane.
Turn right or go straight.
Multiple turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left turn signal.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Only turn when the signal says it is safe.

questions.question: When you turn right on a green light, you must:

options.text: Keep your normal speed.
Stop and look for police cars.
Let pedestrians go first.
Go faster than normal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let pedestrians go first.
questions.explanation: You can turn right on a green light unless a sign says you cannot. But you must let pedestrians and other vehicles in the intersection go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for cars with a certain number of people in them.
You can only turn in certain directions from certain lanes.
Do not enter.
Both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for cars with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and cars with the driver plus the number of passengers shown on the sign.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at a four-way intersection with stop signs at the same time. What happens?

options.text: The driver on the right goes first.
The driver on the left goes first.
One driver can go without stopping.
One driver should honk to show they are yielding.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver on the right goes first.
questions.explanation: Let the driver on your right go first if you both reach a four-way intersection at the same time. You can then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What helps drivers use less gas?

options.text: Leaving the car running in the driveway.
Speeding up quickly.
Slowing down slowly.
Braking hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slowing down slowly.
questions.explanation: Every time you stop quickly, you use fuel to speed back up. Look ahead and slow down gradually or change lanes to avoid hard braking. This saves gas.

questions.question: When you pass a car on a two-lane road with traffic going both ways, you should:

options.text: Go back to your lane when there is enough space between you and the car you passed.
Stay in the left lane if you plan to turn left.
Go back to the right lane right away.
You can drive in either lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go back to your lane when there is enough space between you and the car you passed.
questions.explanation: When passing on a two-lane road, return to the right lane as soon as there is enough space between you and the car you passed.

questions.question: When you park uphill by a curb, you should set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the back tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight.
Turn the steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn the steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill by a curb, set the parking brake and turn the wheel away from the curb. If your car rolls, it will hit the curb and stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A left curve is ahead.
A series of curves is ahead.
An S-curve is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right or continue straight.
Left on arrow only.
Do not enter.
Two-way left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they may turn right or drive straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must turn.
Turn right at the intersection.
Parking area ahead.
A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.
When driving under bad weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block the normal flow of traffic. You can get a ticket for this.

questions.question: When visibility is low, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn on your headlights.
Reduce your speed.
Turn on your windshield wipers.
Look for road edge markings to guide you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Slowing down is the first thing you should do when you cannot see well or roads are unsafe.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean you cannot pass.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:

options.text: An intersection.
A crosswalk.
A railroad crossing.
A blasting zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Broken lines mean you can pass if it is safe.

questions.question: What is a "No zone?"

options.text: A no passing zone.
A one-way traffic area.
The blind spot of a large vehicle.
An area for motor vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle.
questions.explanation: A "No zone" is a blind spot around trucks and large vehicles where the driver cannot see you. Avoid staying in these areas.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Honk at incoming traffic.
Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to reduce congestion.
Change lanes, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When another lane is merging, move to an open lane if you can do so safely to make room for entering traffic.
